supplementaries:globe.text: A rare item found in shipwrecks or sold by the wandering trader Will display a randomly generated blocky world that is unique to your current seed Once interacted with it will spin and display the current world coordinates Every spin will rotate it by one face Will also spin once powered by redstone Can give off a comparator output that depends on the current face. Useful for activation mechanisms
supplementaries:globe.title: Globe

supplementaries:cannon.text: Can shoot any item Shot blocks will be placed (just like with slingshots) Projectile items will be shot as entities (supports all mods) Shooting power depends on the selected gunpowder level Can be placed on all the sides of a block Can be activated by flint and steel, gunpowder trail or redstone Projectiles shot by the player will count as such. Try enderpearls! Each selected gunpowder level will require and consume 1 gunpowder item when cannon is shot Clicking on the maneuver button or shift clicking will activate the maneuver mode Rotate your mouse to aim the cannon precisely where you…
supplementaries:cannon.title: Cannon

supplementaries:cannonball.text: Cannon specific projectile Will break blocks it touches based of its Kinetic Energy Every broken block will subtact energy (speed) from it proportional to the block hardness value Can bounce off the ground when shot from a steep angle Will interact kinetically with all entities, transferring part of its energy to them depending on their mass (hitbox) This include cannonballs themselves, try to bounce them off eachother!
supplementaries:cannonball.title: Cannonball

supplementaries:awning.text: Can be tilted when clicked with an empty hand Shifting while on an awinign will make the player fall through it Falling on an awning will make the player bounce off of it, depending on its angle too! Can be placed on supporting blocks as well as against themselves Can be placed on both upper and lower part of a block
supplementaries:awning.title: Awning

supplementaries:pedestal.text: When stacked vertically will visually connect Can have one item placed on top of them Certain items like swords, tools and tridents and globes will have special visual properties when displayed on a pedestal Once an item is taken or removed from a pedestal the block will give out a observer detectable update. Useful for traps This can be prevented if one swaps the item with a sack If an end crystal is placed on a pedestal the block will give off an enchanting power equal to 3 bookshelves. This means that with 5 of such blocks you'll be able to max out an enchanting table
supplementaries:pedestal.title: Pedestal

supplementaries:bunting.text: Can be placed on Ropes Come in all colors Will swing in the wind Alternatively can be placed on walls and ceilings
supplementaries:bunting.title: Bunting

supplementaries:present.text: A container block which can hold 1 item stack When interacting with its gui you can choose a player to which it will be adressed to as well as a small description Once packed only you and the recipient will be able to open it and access its content Comes in 16 + 1 colors
supplementaries:present.title: Present

supplementaries:pignata.text: Hangs if placed under a block, otherwise it just sits on the floor Can be tied to a lead Right click it with an item to stuff it. Holds 9 stacks. Can be filled by hoppers Bursts after 10 damage, dropping all its content. Fall damage counts too Slowly heals over time
supplementaries:pignata.title: Pigñata

supplementaries:slidy_block.text: Can be pushed with right click If pushed on ice it will keep on moving If pushed on soap it will change direction randomly
supplementaries:slidy_block.title: Sliding Block

supplementaries:ash.text: When a block is burned by fire it will have a change to create one of more ash layer, depending in its flammability Ash layers are affected by gravity and can pile up Can be harvested with a shovel and is used to craft soap Can drop from burning mobs Also found in basalt deltas Rain will slowly wash away ash layers
supplementaries:ash.title: Ash

supplementaries:soap_block.text: Makes entities that walk on it "slip" Can be placed next to a wet sponge which is in contact with a bellow to make the setup emit bubble particles
supplementaries:soap_block.title: Soap Block

supplementaries:sugar_cube.text: Dissolves into particles when it touches water Dissolves in rain
supplementaries:sugar_cube.title: Sugar Cube

supplementaries:gravel_bricks.text: When jumping on it or falling on it, the block will break Can be made into a Suspicious variant holding any item
supplementaries:gravel_bricks.title: Gravel Bricks

supplementaries:notice_board.text: Can hold and display either a written book, a map or a banner pattern When it's displaying a written book it will only show one page at the time The text resolution that is getting displayed depends on the amount of text in a page. Add whitespaces to make it render smaller Once given a redstone pulse it will turn the currently displayed page onto the next one Can be waxed to prevent interactions
supplementaries:notice_board.title: Notice Board

supplementaries:fodder.text: A layered block that serves as a way to automatically feed animals Many animals (controlled via a tag) will try to eat a layer out of the block when they are hungry When eaten it will make baby animals age faster and will set adults in love. Uses the vanilla cooldown Can be placed down with dispensers Clicking with a hoe will remove and destroy one layer
supplementaries:fodder.title: Fodder

supplementaries:bamboo_spikes.text: Spikes that will slow and damage all the mobs that walk in them If quark or create are installed they can be pushed with pistons or contraptions and will deal extra damage if they hit something while extending Can be infused with lingering potions. To do so either craft them, click on them or pour the potion using a faucet By default they can only accept negative lingering potions and have infinite charge. You can however enable an alternative mode in the configs which allows them to have 16 changes and accept any potion. Charges will only be depleted when an entity that does not have that…
supplementaries:bamboo_spikes.title: Bamboo Spikes

supplementaries:hat_stand.text: Like an armor stand but just the head Shift click with empty had to wobble it
supplementaries:hat_stand.title: Hat Stand

supplementaries:planter.text: Can support any plant or crop without the need of water, useful for nether farms Also prevent the crop from being trampled Have optional farmers delight rich soil support
supplementaries:planter.title: Planter

supplementaries:blackboard.text: Can be written on to create interesting pattern in black and white. Basically a bare bones MS Paint in Minecraft Can also be directly edited without the GUI by holding a dye item. This also supports other mods like chalk or similar items like quatz or coal. Doing so won't consume the item Will keep its drawing when broken. The current drawing can be previewed using the item tool tip Blackboards can be duplicated just like banners Can be cleared by using a wet sponge or soap Can be waxed to prevent interactions Can accept glow ink Colored blackboards can be enabled in the configs
supplementaries:blackboard.title: Blackboard

supplementaries:safe.text: Acts as a sort of upgraded shulker box that is fire resistant Safes can be locked with a key. Once this is done their content will only be available to players that have the correct key in their inventory. See the key section for more info An optional config is avialable in the configs that allows them to get bounded to the first player the places them, without the need to use a key To unlock and clear the ownership of a safe simply shift click on it with its key or a tripwire hook if simple safes are enabled In the configs one can also enable an option to make them indestructible unless one…
supplementaries:safe.title: Safe

supplementaries:feather_block.text: Extremely fluffy! When fallen or stepped upon will emit feather particles and will let the player slowly fall into it, negating all fall damage
supplementaries:feather_block.title: Feather Block

supplementaries:doormat.text: Can hold and display 3 lines of text Cats will occasionally sit on it One single item can be hidden below it. To do so shift click on any face except the top one
supplementaries:doormat.title: Doormat

supplementaries:flower_box.text: Can hold tall flowers and similar plants (such as vines, cave vines, nether vines and such) Can be configured to hold up to 3 plants instead Can be placed in the middle of a block or to the side in all directions and even hanged from ceilings
supplementaries:flower_box.title: Flower Box

supplementaries:statue.text: Can hold an item in hand Some items have special visuals like candles, tools and swords When powered with redstone it will wave Patreons and donators can access unique statues with their skins through renaming one with their name
supplementaries:statue.title: Statue

supplementaries:sack.text: Acts as an early game shulker box with 9 slots Sacks are heavy and when carrying more than 2 the player will have the overencumbered effect applied Mod includes a tag that you can assign to other items to make them behave like this too Is a gravity block and will deal damage when it falls on an entity. Damage depends on sack content Its slots and properties are configurable in the configs Can be interacted with similar to a bundle With quark installed it also has a fancy tooltip
supplementaries:sack.title: Sack

supplementaries:wind_vane.text: Visually swing depending on the current weather in your Minecraft world. It will output a redstone signal, the strength of which depends on the current weather so 1 power when raining and 2 when thundering. Also provide strong power to the block below making it ideal for rooftop applications When hit with a wind charge will spin quickly and emit power level 3
supplementaries:wind_vane.title: Wind Vane

supplementaries:cog_block.text: Acts as a form of upgraded redstone in solid block form. Pretty intuitive to use, you just power one and it will power its adjacent cogs, up to 14 blocks away, just like with redstone dust. The real use for this is to be able to make compact vertical redstone signaling.
supplementaries:cog_block.title: Cog Block

supplementaries:crystal_display.text: When powered displays a number or a symbol depending on what the received signal strength Has emissive textures
supplementaries:crystal_display.title: Crystal Display

supplementaries:relayer.text: Observer like block whose purpose is to copy whatever signal it has in front to its back Also works with indirect power when it faces a redstone wire Useful to reliably transmit analog power without dispersion A signal takes 1 game tick to travel through a relayer Useful to power an array of Crystal Displays or other similar blocks as multiple relayer chains can be stacked next to eachother without interfering
supplementaries:relayer.title: Relayer

supplementaries:grouper.text: An automation redstone block that compares what is on its two sides and outputs a signal from its back. It has two kind of matches: a strong one and a weak one giving weak and strong power respectively. A strong match gives full power (15). It happens when the two blocks are exactly identical, blockstate included A weak match gives half power (7). It happens when the two are the same block but in a different state, like two stairs facing different ways, a lit and an unlit furnace or crops at different ages This lets you tell apart "same block" from "exact same block" just by reading the…
supplementaries:grouper.title: Grouper

supplementaries:spring_launcher.text: When activated it extends like a piston and will propel any entities that lie ontop of it in the direction it's moving, twice as far as the vanilla piston-slime block setup. Additionally, it can also push you up if you were to fall on it from a certain height when it's already extended. Try it out, it's really fun! Cannot push blocks like a normal piston, only entities Allows entities that stand on an extended one to jump slightly higher
supplementaries:spring_launcher.title: Spring Launcher

supplementaries:speaker_block.text: Can send a message in chat to all players in a certain radius when activated by redstone Alternatively it also provides a "narrator mode" which will send the message via the game narrator instead Its radius(volume) and message can be edited via its gui Can be renamed in an anvil to change the name that will be displayed in chat. Rename it "" to get rid of it completely
supplementaries:speaker_block.title: Speaker Block

supplementaries:turn_table.text: Can change the orientation of the block that it's facing Can rotate many special blocks too like stairs on their horizontal axis Once powered it will initiate a rotation action which will take time depending on the signal strength it is receiving. The rotation action will continue regardless if the block is powered or not and it's indicated by a red light on the block itself If given a short pulse it will only perform one rotation Rotation frequency (or speed for entities) depends on the redstone power the block has Toggling the block by right clicking will reverse the rotation direction Can…
supplementaries:turn_table.title: Turn Table

supplementaries:pulley_block.text: Has a single inventory slot which can accept any chain or rope like block It cannot be powered by redstone When a turn table rotates the block (providing it's connected to the right axis) it will start deploying or retracting the items it's holding in its inventory, depending if it's getting rotated clock-wise or counter clock-wise If a rope below it is retracted manually by shift clicking (see the rope section), the resulting rope item will get redirected in the pulley inventory When rotated it will also rotate all the pulleys adjacent to it that are facing the same axis Can also be rotated…
supplementaries:pulley_block.title: Pulley Block

supplementaries:clock_block.text: Visually displays the current in-game time. The Hour hand indicates the current in-game hour while the minute hand ticks every irl second Its output can be read with a comparator which will give off a signal from 0 to 15 that is proportional to the in-game time which is from 0 to 24 Provides a way to have accurate time keeping in game, not obtainable otherwise (daylight sensors are rendered useless when it's raining for example) Gives off a block update detectable by an observer each time an in-game hour passes Like all clocks does not work in the nether Clicking on it will display the…
supplementaries:clock_block.title: Clock Block

supplementaries:bellows.text: When powered will push air infront of it with frequency that is proportional to its redstone power. All the effects here described are affected by this When pushing air it will push entities that are infront of it away, up to a 5 blocks distance Speeds up furnace-like blocks that are right next to it Refreshes fire blocks in-front of it. Fire blocks that are up to a 2 blocks distance will be kept alive indefinitely Can be placed facing any direction When stepped on, if not powered, it will compress Can speed up copper aging if placed right next to one If placed in front of a wet sponge that…
supplementaries:bellows.title: Bellows

supplementaries:redstone_illuminator.text: Gives off a light output that is inversely proportional to its current redstone power. This means it's on by default
supplementaries:redstone_illuminator.title: Redstone Illuminator

supplementaries:crank.text: Provides a variable redstone signal that depends on its turn ratio. Basically a an analog lever Can be turned clockwise or counterclockwise (shift right click)
supplementaries:crank.title: Crank

supplementaries:faucet.text: An extremely powerful multi purpose block Can be activated by right clicking its handle When powered its active and non active status will be inverted Can extract items from the inventory below and spill them right below its nozzle with a one second interval If placed next to a fluid containing block it will start dripping fluid particles and show a visual fluid tray right below it if it's active Once it's connected to a fluid containing block behind it can pour those fluids in any possible fluid container block below it. This will only be possible in 250mb increment Fluid containing blocks…
supplementaries:faucet.title: Faucet

supplementaries:hourglass.text: Can be filled with any kind of sand, dust or powder or even slime and honey Once filled the dust will slowly start falling downward with a time that depends on the material used Can give a comparator output that depends on the remaining time. Useful for timed mechanisms Can be reset by either rotating twice with a turn table or by shift clicking To view or edit the timings for each items you can check the mod data folder. Check customization page
supplementaries:hourglass.title: Hourglass

supplementaries:lock_block.text: Can be locked with a key similar to safes and netherite doors. See that section for more info Once it interacts with a player that holds the correct key it will emit a redstone pulse
supplementaries:lock_block.title: Lock Block

supplementaries:sconce_lever.text: A mix between a sconce and a lever If unlit it will have its properties reversed
supplementaries:sconce_lever.title: Sconce Lever

supplementaries:slingshot.text: A tool that can shoot blocks! Shot blocks will place themselves wherever they land if the position is suitable Can be enchanted with Quick Charge, Multi Shot and Stasis Stasis is a new enchantment just for slingshot and can be found in end cities A Slingshot enchanted with Stasis will be able to shoot in a straight line without being affected by gravity and will additionally gain a white block outline that will indicate where the projectile will land
supplementaries:slingshot.title: Slingshot

supplementaries:quiver.text: Skeletons can rarely spawn with it in higher difficulties. They will shoot random tipped arrows and can drop the item You can add arrows to a quiver by clicking a stack onto one in your inventoy just like with a bundle Another way to obtain it is through mansion or dungeon chests Its main use is to quickly switch between arrows. To do so use the item and it will open an ingame GUI Player wont be slowed while using the item and can cycle through selected arrows with mouse movement, arrow keys, number keys or scroll wheel Alternatively shift right click also cycles through selected arrows…
supplementaries:quiver.title: Quiver

supplementaries:lunch_basket.text: Can hold any food item, up to 9 stacks of them Press Right Click to open/close the item Once open you can eat from it the food it contains Press Left Click to switch the food you have selected. The item must be closed first though Shift Click to place the item down as a block
supplementaries:lunch_basket.title: Lunch Basket

supplementaries:confetti_popper.text: Makes confetti. Fun! Can be placed on your head for a party hat Creepers can also wear them! Watch out for the explosions though Shift to place one layer on the ground
supplementaries:confetti_popper.title: Confetti Popper

supplementaries:altimeter.text: Visually shows current height Texture changes with elevation and dimension Custom ones can be added aswell by following same convention as the ones already added Right clicking will show y level By default texture scrolls 1 pixel up every 4 blocks Animation cam be made smoother in configs
supplementaries:altimeter.title: Altimeter

supplementaries:flute.text: Can be bound to pets (or horses) by clicking it on the animal in question Can be played to summon nearby non sitting bound pets to the player When used will play a random song from a selected list Extra songs can be easily recorded with the /supplementaries record command and can be added with a datapack. Check out the Customisation section for more info If renamed to the name of an existing song it will play that all the time. Check customization section for more
supplementaries:flute.title: Flute

supplementaries:wrench.text: Wrenches are a handy tool which can be used to rotate any kind of rotateable block They even work on blocks you might not expect them to like signs, way signs, double skulls, double chests and beds Shift right click to reverse the rotation direction The rotation axis will be the one of the face you click They can also rotate some entities like item frames and armor stand (this interaction requires left clicking tho) Additionally wrenches double as a fast melee weapon which deals same damage as a wooden sword but is much faster and can even be enchanted with knockback
supplementaries:wrench.title: Wrench

supplementaries:soap.text: Can be crafted with many dyed items to revert them to their default or white state. Works with all modded ones too Can also be used directly on all those in world Can clean dyed armor items Can be used on copper like blocks to clean away any waxing and oxidation in one use Can be used on pets, sheeps, slimes and withers to wash them Can also wash away blackboards, antique globes and maps, sticky pistons and tipped spikes and others
supplementaries:soap.title: Soap

supplementaries:rope_arrow.text: Once shot it will try to deploy a rope coil wherever it lands Can be crafted to hold up to 24 ropes (can be configured in the configs) Useful when adventuring caves Shot rope arrows will retain all the ropes they didn't place so remember to pick them back up
supplementaries:rope_arrow.title: Rope Arrow

supplementaries:bubble_blower.text: A fun novelty item which you can use to blow soap bubbles at your friends Can be recharged by crafting it with soap If enchanted with Stasis it gains an actual useful functionality which allows it to place fancy soap bubble blocks in mid air wherever you aim
supplementaries:bubble_blower.title: Bubble Blower

supplementaries:antique_ink.text: A rare item which is often found in urns, fishing loot or sold by master cartographers Can be used on any sign to change its font to a fancy Antiquable font Can be crafted with a map to turn it into a Antique Map, giving it a treasure map like look Can be crafted with a globe to get a Sepia Globe Can be crafted with an original written book to turn it into a Tattered book. Tattered books cant be copied and will use the Antiquable font
supplementaries:antique_ink.title: Antique Ink

supplementaries:key.text: Keys are used to lock Safes, Netherite Doors, Netherite Trapdoors and Lock Blocks To lock a block first rename the key to your desired password, the click on the unbounded block To clear the ownership simply shift click with the correct key on the locked block To open a locked block you won't need to have the correct key in hand, it just needs to be in your inventory or Curio slot Can be used in a dispenser to open key lockable blocks. Useful with lock blocks
supplementaries:key.title: Key

supplementaries:candy.text: A simple food item that is fast to eat and will fill up half a hunger bar One might experience side effect if too many are eaten at once
supplementaries:candy.title: Candy

supplementaries:flax.text: Flax seeds can be rarely found in chests (most noticeably the pillager outpost chest), sold by the wandering trader or obtained through wild flax Flax is a plant that grows two blocks tall and can be farmed to craft many newly added blocks such as ropes, sacks, fodder and doormats
supplementaries:flax.title: Flax

supplementaries:enderman_head.text: Will open it's mouth and emit a redstone signal when being stared at Signal strength depends on how long you look at it Drops like other heads Can't be stacked or have candles on it
supplementaries:enderman_head.title: Enderman head

supplementaries:raked_gravel.text: Use a hoe on a block of gravel to rake it in the direction you are facing Unlike farmland it can be tilled in all directions and can curve too
supplementaries:raked_gravel.title: Raked Gravel

supplementaries:wild_flax.text: Flax can rarely spawn in its wild form along bodies of water in desert and arid biomes
supplementaries:wild_flax.title: Wild Flax

Amendments: Amendments.text: This section is dedicated to the Amendments mod (get it here) The reason why its wiki is being kept here is purely practical. Following will be a list of features divided by block to which they have been added

Amendments: Lanterns.text: Vanilla and modded lanterns can now be placed on walls! Wall lanterns are animated with actual physics and will swing if they are hit by an entity Animation and fancy renderer can be disabled and replaced with a static block model in the config. This could give a very slight fps boost (this option is also always on when looking at them at a certain distance) Lanterns will have a unique animation when in first or third person Works with any modded lantern and is controlled by a tag

Amendments: Cauldrons.text: Can store ANY liquid Can be used to Mix Potions and Dyes When clicked on will attempt to craft the item in your hand with the liquid they contain Have improved animations with splash and bubble particles when falling on as well as missing sounds When holding water or a potion can Boil if they have a heat source below Boiling cauldrons can inflict boiling damage Stepping into a splash or lingering potion cauldron will apply that potion Improved model with Translucency and Ambient Occlusion Can be used to brew stews. Just throw the correct ingredients into a boiling water cauldron

Amendments: Lecterns.text: When holding a Book and Quill will have a new GUI that adds a Quill button and an Ink Well button Click on the Ink Well to cycle between available font colors Click on the Quill to cycle between available fonts Can now interact with hoppers!

Amendments: Hanging Signs.text: Can hold any item on both their faces Can also display a banner patterns (requires Supplementaries) When attached to walls will swing with physics! Will display a visual connection when attached to fence, walls or similar blocks

Amendments: Jukeboxes.text: Now visually show the disc they are playing They come with new and improved model Disc show will also spin while it's playing Works with ANY disc, modded or not

Amendments: Carpets.text: Can be placed on Slabs Can be placed on Stairs Same goes for moss carpets

Amendments: Cakes.text: Can be stacked by placing two ontop of eachother. Works with ANY cake Vanilla cakes can also be rotated

Amendments: Lilypads.text: Can have any block placed on them This works by making them occupy the block below, turning them into a waterlogged block Will revert back when the block is removed Can be made to work with any lilypad (feedback needed)

Amendments: Mob Heads.text: Can be stacked. Works with ANY skull in any combination Can have candles placed ontop Candle will leave a wax overlay on the skull

Amendments: Bell Chain Ringing.text: One can now interact with a set of chains or ropes attached to the bottom of a bell. Doing so will ring the bell itself Bells will also visually connect to those chains and ropes.

Amendments: Brewing Stands.text: Now will have their potion bottles colored according to what they are holding

Customization: Configs.text: Almost every aspect of the mod can be toggled or disabled. This is mostly handled by configs. To edit these you can either do it manually with a text editor or install the mod Configured to do it from the ingame menu All configs are commented with a description that explain what they do so I wont need to explain those here With Configured installed you can access the config menu by pressing the "s" button in your esc menu (or turn it on in the configs if its disabled once you get there) or by typing /supplementaries configured in chat You will find 3 config files in your /configs directory,…

Customization: Client Configs.text: Client contains settings that are client only and mainly related to visuals

Customization: Common Configs.text: Common contains most of the logic used by the mod and includes many optional features that are off by default like for example colored blackbords or xp bottling

Customization: Registry Configs.text: Registry is used to turn off single blocks and items rather than features

Customization: Texture Pack.text: As with any other mod you can change the mod textures and models with a texture pack. Here are listed a couple of things you can also do that might not seem obvious: Add new Soft Fluid textures in the /softfluid folder to then use for your custom fluids definitions that you can add with datapacks Add custom models for Wall Lanterns for any of your modded lanterns so that their wall stand will look just like you want. To do so you will simply have to add a model json file and a texture file in your resource pack /blocks/walllanterns folder. Note that the path of your model json has to match…

Customization: Datapack.text: If you aren't familiar datapacks are a powerful Vanilla tool are a way of exposing in-game internals through an easy to use interface that allows players to change many aspects of the game through simple text (.json) files. Datapacks are the server side equivalent of resource packs Making simple datapacks is very easy and if you have never done it there are many tutorials online but in short it's just a matter of creating a folder and fill it up with text files in the right location. Said folder structure can be viewed by looking at the mod builtin datapack. See below. The main resource for…

Customization: Tags.text: The mod contains many tags that control alot of its features. Tags can be found under /data/[modid]/tags/ in any mod or datapack data folder If you want to add entries to one simply include a new tag json file in your datapack with only the new entries. They will get merged. If you want to remove entries you'll have to copy the existing file and set the replace property to true I'll list here some of the most popular ones and you can check out the entire list by viewing the mod builtin datapack cagecatchable and jarcatchable : determines which mob can go in cages and jars eatsfodder : a list…

Customization: Recipes and Loot Tables.text: This one is obvious but if you've never seen them before just letting you know that recipes and loot tables (from any mod) can be added and configured with datapacks By overriding or changing a loot tables you can alter what mobs drops and what is found in chests including stuff added by supplementaries. Here to check /data/[modid]/loottables/ folder

Customization: Worldgen Features.text: This one is tricky and i heavily recommend checking out the official wikis. The TLDR to disable a feature or strcture is the following: To disable it you could either overide the tag of biomes where they spawn, override the feature/structure json with a NO-OP one, add an always false forge/fabric load conditions to those jsons. Supplementaries unique data objects:

Customization: Custom Structure Maps Tra.text: Located in data/structuremaps or data/minecraft/moonlight/villagertrades/[villager profession] (1.20+) folder, these json allow you to define custom villager trades that lead to specific structures Here is an example json. Only the first parameter is needed as the others are optional and will default to reasonable values The MapMarker parameter represend an id of a registered Map Marker, either vanilla or custom. See below 1.20+ Only first 3 param are needed. Rest is optional. Names are self explicative. Note that structure can be structure id, tag (#) or structure list with [] before 1.20

Customization: Custom Villager trades.text: Similarly to what used above thanks to Moonlight you can also add custom trades to any villager (see its page). Located in data/[villager mod id]/moonlight/villagertrades/[villager profession name] folder. I suggest to check out the mod own data folder as an example for this. Here is the basic simple trade json type. Note that other more specialized ones exist. See mod datapack for example. Here only first 3 parameters are required, rest is optional. You can also add biome variant trades as follows (1.21+): Supplementaries also adds other trade types, best way to tackle this is to just have a…

Customization: Removing Custom Villager.text: To remove a custom tarde simply place a json file in its location with the following content. This is very similar to how it's done for other data files for vanilla datapacks entries. To remove all trades of a level use the type removeallnondata (only in newer versions)

Customization: Custom placeable books.text: You can add modded books to placeable ones and even give them custom models depending on the itemstack components too or even randomization. To do so youll need a data file and a resource pack files. The 2 folders are the datapack registry folder supplementaries/placeablebooks and the resource pack folder placeablebooksvisuals. You can check out the mod own data and resource pack for examples.

Customization: Map Markers.text: This section allows one to register new custom map markers to the Custom Map Marker system that the mod adds These are found in data/[datapackname]/moonlight/mapmarkers folder. You will also have to provide a texture for it to use. This can be added in your resource pack under assets/[packname]/textures/mapmarker/[id].png, where id is simply the name of the json you just added targetblock is a rule test and can be used to have a marker that represents a block. When that is there clicking on the block with a map will add the marker to it. If you for example would want to add a to TNT blocks…

Customization: Soft Fluids.text: Soft fluids is the internal data system used by Jars and Goblets These are found in data/[datapackname]/moonlight/softfluids folder. These differ from standard Forge Fluids as they never have a block form, aren't registered to the fluid registry and instead provide a system that is simpler and more focused on item interactions. They are specifically designed to work well with bottles and bowls as well as allowing each fluid to inherit the food properties of said items As such the base unit measure they use is 1 bottle as opposed to one bucket. This equals to 250MB in terms of forge fluids.…

Customization: Hourglass Dusts.text: All parameters related to hourglass dusts can be tweaked via the jsons in the hourglassdusts folder Check out the already provided ones for an example, its self explanatory as they just contain texture and timing information. Heres an example

Customization: Flute Songs.text: This folder contains all the songs that will be added to the flute song list (you can view the mod builtin one to see all the existing songs) To add new ones I advise against doing it manually and instead you can register your noteblocks contraptions ingame using the /supplementaries record command To do so just type /supplementaries record start. This one can also be followed by an instrument list to limit the recording to said instruments. Once the song has played just type /supplementaries record stop [name] where [name] is the file name you want to save it to. Here you also have an…

Customization: Placeable Blooks definiti.text: Check out their respective folders in the mod resource/data pack

Customization: Captured Mobs Properties.text: This folder contains information on how various mobs should be treated when captured by cages and jars Here is what each parameter means. Note that only the first 3 here are needed, the rest is optional. owners, a list of mob ids that this json should be applied to. Can contain ones that aren't installed too widthincrement and heightincrement, used to virtually "increase" a mob hitbox when inside a container. This will make them render smaller. Useful for mobs whose hitbox does not match their model like a chicken for example whose head is way proud of their collision box. lightlevel, light…

Customization: Soap Cleaning.text: These are found inside data/[èack namespace]/coloredsets and can define behavior of color sets. mostly used by soap. Note that these are just overrides as the existing color set logic already groups most items and blocks correctly automatically. Example json:

Customization: Mob Head Shaders.text: These are found in the mobheadeffects RESOURCE PACK folder (yes not datapack one) Here is what one of those could look like. Note that the shader that's defined here is a post shader in the post shaders folder. The defined entities are what give the shader while in spectator while the item will apply it when worn.

Customization: Flower Box Models.text: Found inside flowerboxplants RESOURCE PACK folder, these jsons allow you to add custom models for plants that go in flower boxes, both when normal mode or simple mode is enabled (tall flowers only). Note that to add a new plant to flower boxes, its item should also be tagged as supplementaries:flowerboxtallplantable or supplementaries:flowerboxplantable. Here is an example json. Note that items can be a list too.

Functional-Blocks: Candle Holders.text: Can be placed on walls, floors and ceilings Can be stacked up to 4 to create candelabras and chandeliers Give off a bit more light that candles making them viable light sources Like sconces can be lit up and extinguished in many ways like with fire charges, flaming arrows, gunpowder or shovels to name a few come in 17 colors

Functional-Blocks: Flags.text: Essentially an horizontal banner Will swing in the wind and have a fancy animation option that can be enabled in the configs or viewed with fabulous graphics Due to the different resolution and shape they use a different set of texture for their patterns. This means that new unique shapes can be created Can be crafted from existing banners and come in all colors Can be lowered and raised if placed on top a pole made with placeable sticks

Functional-Blocks: Lunch Box.text: Can hold any food item, up to 9 stacks of them Press Right Click to open/close the item Once open you can eat from it the food it contains Press Left Click to switch the food you have selected. The item must be closed first though Shift Click to place the item down as a block

Functional-Blocks: Lumisene Liquid.text: A finite liquid Up to 16 layers can be in a single block Will spread out evenly as thin as possible A bucket can deploy and scoop exactly 16 connected layers Has unique light properties Cool iridescent animated texture Can be lit on fire and instantly spreads to all connected blocks Stepping on can apply the flammable effect for a few seconds Drinking from a bottle will apply the glowing effect and the flammable one Flammable effext extends the on fire duration and makes the affected entity spread fire as they walk Floats on water

Functional-Blocks: Hanging Signs (1.19-).text: Can hold and display either text, an item or a banner pattern or even a map Can be attached to the bottom of a block or to the side and will visually connect to fences and walls Will visually swing when hit by entities

Functional-Blocks: Framed Blocks.text: Framed blocks come in 3 shapes: Braces, Cross Braces and Frames Each of them can visually hold any solid block inside. This allows to make every block into a framed one. To do so simply click on it with said block An option to frame an already placed block when clicking on it with this item is available in the configs Using an axe on a framed block will break the frame but not the block contained inside

Functional-Blocks: Daub and Wattle & Dau.text: A new medieval themed decorative block that goes hand it hand with framed blocks When daub is placed inside a framed block it will convert into the respective wattle and daub

Functional-Blocks: Netherite Doors & Tra.text: Just like safes they can be locked with keys. Once this is done only a key owner can interact with them By default they are accessible to anyone until first locked

Functional-Blocks: Gold Doors & Trapdoor.text: When powered by redstone will disable any interaction with any player This means that a powered door cannot be opened or closed regardless of its state Creative players can bypass locks

Functional-Blocks: Iron Gates.text: Decorative item that acts as an upgraded fence gate Can visually connect with other gates that are placed ontop of them

Functional-Blocks: Ropes.text: Can be placed against a ceiling, on a fence or wall or next to an already placed rope Just like scaffolding they can only go that far out horizontally from their closest support until they are no longer supported Vertical ropes have no hitbox and can be climbed Horizontal ropes do have a hitbox and can be walked on, albeit at a slower pace. Your screen will also wobble as you try to balance on them Can be broken by a projectile. Doing so or breaking them will also break connected ropes which are being supported. Shearing a rope will make remove its bottom connection Placing a rope against an…

Functional-Blocks: Flint Block.text: A decorative and storage block that can provide a use for your extra flints When pushed by a piston it can scrape agains any full face iron-like block to produce sparks. If a flammable block is nearby it will catch fire! This allows to have a on demand durationless flint and steel Opposite also works which means you can move an iron block agains a flint block instead These interactions also work with Quark magnets Stepping on one with some iron boots will also set stuff on fire

Functional-Blocks: Sconce, Candelabras a.text: Decorative items that are meant to provide an alternative to torches Can be lit with flint and still, fire charges, fi re arrows or placeable gunpowder Can be unilt by waterlogging or by using a water splash potion Won't break when waterlogged

Functional-Blocks: Way Signs.text: Up to two of them can be placed on any fence or placed stick Their orientation depends on the way the player faces when placing them Their direction is always set but it can be reversed by shift clicking one Click on one with a compass to make it point toward the pointer position (either the world spawn or lodestone position) Like all signs they support dyes and inks Can also be placed against walls

Functional-Blocks: Goblets.text: Can hold and display any liquid Valid liquids include normal fluids, potions, honey, milk and so many others with support from many mods too. If you see something in a bottle or bowl it can likely be accepted as a fluid. Any displayed liquid, if drinkable, can be drinked directly and instantly by clicking on it. Interacts with comparators

Functional-Blocks: Cages.text: Can be used to capture small animals and mobs To do so right or left click a mob with a cage item Right click with a full cage to release the mob To place the block down you will need to shift right click The list of mobs that can be captured can is controlled by an entity tag which already includes many modded mobs One can also enable a dynamic list which will whitelist all mobs that are detected to be small enough Captured mobs will not age nor be interactable and some will have some custom animations. Chickens can still lay eggs while captured

Functional-Blocks: Jars.text: Can store up to 12 cookie like items. Include many modded ones Stored cookies can be directly eaten by interacting with it Just like cages it can store and capture small mobs. The whitelist is different though Jars can store up to 12 bottles (or 3k mb) of fluids. This follows the same logic that goblets use. Refer to that section for more information If enabled in the configs, one can drink directly from jars, both in item and block form Note that the entire fluid system used by jars is extremely customizable and data driven. This means you can add custom fluids using datapacks!

Functional-Blocks: New Building Blocks.text: New Blocks: Blackstone Tiles & Lantern, Stone Tiles & Lantern, Deepslate Lantern, Endstone Lanter, Checker Block, Ash Bricks, Fine Wood Just some simple building blocks that I felt were missing. Oddly enough that's all. Crazy I know xD

Home: Features.text: Redstone Blocks Functional Blocks Tools, Foods and Items Tweaks World and Entities Mod Integration Our Other Mods

Home: Configs.text: Supplementaries is a highly customizable mod and includes many options to tweak it exactly how you want Refer to the related config section here Note that this Wiki is contains information relevant to the latest mod Forge version. This means that you'll find newer features not present on older versions while for fabric latest version some small features here and there might be missing or worse

Mod-Integration: Indirect Integration.text: Cage and jar catchable tags which allow many other mods to be captured in those items Fluid support for many modded bottles and soups which can be filled in jars and goblets Full support for all modded banner patterns for flags. This works out of the box and already includes many custom textures for many popular mods' banner patterns Rope tags for many modded ropes and chains. This allows them to be accepted by pulleys and rope arrows Support for many special potted pants for flower boxes. This mainly includes extra flower potted plants from quark (things like wheat and carrots for example)…

Mod-Integration: Direct Integration and.text: Roped and Stick-Logged Tomato vines blocks from Farmers Delight. This allows for the base tomato vine block to grow onto placed sticks or ropes. The rope-logged block will maintain both the tomato properties and the underlying block ones. Sticks can now also be placed on the first stage of a tomato vine directly onto farmland Custom Configured mod menu, a slightly edited mod menu provided by the configured mod which just has some extra icons and eyecandies Custom Cloth Config and YACL mod menu, same story as with configured one but to a lesser extent Quark Tater in a Jar. Do I need to say…

Our-Other-Mods: Sleep Tight.text: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/sleep-tight A very comprehensive fully configurable rebalance and overhaul of the Minecraft sleeping system. The mod offers Hammocks which can swing Night bags Home bed and sleep reward mechanic Bed bugs Nightmares Sleep encounters

Our-Other-Mods: Haunted Harvest.text: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/haunted-harvest A mod aimed at expanding some autumnal aspect of the game. It offers: Pumpkin carving, similar to blackboards Corn crop, fully integrated Baby villager trick or treating AI Adult villager place pumpkins in autumn Abandoned barn, a new spooky structure you'll find in the wild Candies!

Our-Other-Mods: Snowy Spirit.text: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/snowy-spirit A winter themed mod which introduces a fun new ride Sleds, a realistic easily manouverable ride wose physics allows for an awesome ski course. Can be pulled by wolves too! Villager Winter AI, makes them place presents from Supplementaries Ginger, a new seasonal crop, includes modded food recipes Candycanes and Gingerbread blocks

Our-Other-Mods: Supplementaries Squared.text: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/supplementaries-squared A mod where all scrapped or requested content that i didnt find fitting goes. Mainly include many block variants of existing supplementaries blocks. Variant Item Shelves Colored Sacks Metal Frames Plaques Gold Candle Holders

Our-Other-Mods: Heartstones.text: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/heartstone Never loose your important ones with this nifty little gadget

Redstone-Blocks: Magma Cream Block (1.16.text: When pushed by a piston it will only attach itself with the block that faces its sticky (yellow) face Lateral faces will act in a sort of semi-sticky way where they will stick but only to other magma blocks that are facing the same direction Acts as a sort of directional slime block Such functionality depends on the Quark mod Can damage entities that are standing on it

Tools,-Foods-and-Items: Cannon Boats.text: A cannon on a boat. What else do you want? Press Ctrl to fire while driving or space to enter maneuver mode Illagers on a cannon boat will be able to use it and shoot stuff at you!

Tools,-Foods-and-Items: Slice Maps.text: Display the world as viewed from a certain y level Slice map y level is decided whenever its first created Require the player to stand on or have view on the target level, so to avoid x-ray Have reduced range than normal maps Pair well with "Map Atlases" mod

Tools,-Foods-and-Items: Stasis Enchantme.text: Rarely found in end cities Can be applied to slingshots and bubble blowers

Tools,-Foods-and-Items: Bomb & Blue Bomb.text: A consumable projectile that will explode wherever it lands Such explosion will only deal damage to mobs without destroying any block, with the exception of blocks that can be removed by water like tall grass Blue Bombs are a more powerful version of bombs. They can be found by exploring, usually in chests When exploding they can ignite nearby creepers A blue bomb explosion will deal significant area damage to entities, will set them on fire and will afflict them with a weakness debuff Blue Bombs do not explode on impact, instead they will flash once they hit something, giving players a split…

Tools,-Foods-and-Items: Pancakes.text: Similar to cakes they can only be eaten when placed Can be placed in a pile of up to 8 Honey can be poured on them (either via faucet or by clicking with a bottle) They can also accept other toppings such as chocolate and syrup, available for compatibility with other mods that add such items Pancakes with honey, chocolate or syrup will give a short speed effect when eaten You can also insert a pancake in a jukebox for some sick tunes!

Tools,-Foods-and-Items: Music Discs.text: One can be obtained by one shotting a creeper with a cannonball The other is a pancake

Tweaks: Tweaks.text: Note that some of theres features were moved to the Amendments mod. Refer to the Amendments section on this wiki to see the full list of features. They will also remain here as they are relevant for older versions

Tweaks: Custom Map Markers.text: You can now place some new markers on maps. To do so just click with a map on one of the required blocks. The supported blocks are: Beacon, Beds, Signs, Nether Portal, Bell, Campfires, Conduit, Lodestone, Spawners, Respawn Anchors, End Portal and Flags Some of these blocks will show the block name if they hold text or are renamed, just like vanilla banners Additionally all structures of note rom base game and a few oter mods will have custom map markers. These are only obtainable through the map loot function or ingame via the Adventurer or Custom Maps Villager trades feature.

Tweaks: Colored maps.text: Maps will now show biome and block colours for all blocks tagged as "supplementaries:tintedonmaps"

Tweaks: Mob Head Tweaks.text: Wearing a mob head will give you the spectator effect that you usually get when spectating them Extra ones have been added aswell such as for enderman head, skeleton, dragon and piglin

Tweaks: Adventurer Maps.text: Cartographers can now sell Adventurer Maps on their second trade Adventurer maps are just like mansion maps but can lead to many different vanilla structures. The catch is that you won't know which one until you open the map Adventurer maps make use of the new map icon system and have a custom icon for each structure The list of possible structures they can lead to are: Jungle Temples, Desert Pyramids, Villages, Shipwrecks, Mineshafts, Ruined Portals, Witch Huts, Igloo, Pillager Outposts, Ocean Ruin, End Cities and Bastions Additionally one can easily add new custom maps that can lead to any…

Tweaks: Placeable Gunpowder.text: Gunpowder trails can be placed on the ground They can be lit up via fire arrows, fire charges, fire, lava, magma blocks and other fire sources Once lit up the trail will quickly start to consume itself and it will propagate to the next one Lit trails can ignite tnt, set flammable blocks on fire or light up blocks that can be lit up, like campfires or candles alike

Tweaks: Zombie Horse Conversion.text: Feeding a stack of rotten flesh to a owned skeleton horse will slowly convert it into a zombie horse Additionally zombie horses can breath underwater just like skeleton ones

Tweaks: Placeable Books.text: Enchanted and normal books can be placed and thus have a block form By default normal books can be piled horizontally and will have a random color assigned to them Enchanted Books will be piled up vertically Placed books can give enchanting power to enchanting tables. The power given depends on the number and type of books used This supports colored books from Inspirations mod and Tomes from Quark mod By enabling mixed books in the config one can mix and match any book with each other and, for example, place enchanted books sideways Placeable book and quill can also be enabled in the configs…

Tweaks: Quiver Skeletons.text: Skeletons can now rarely spawn equipped with quiver. This depends on difficulty similar to enchanted armor on them so you will not see them on easy or peaceful and only after a while on normal Skeletons with quivers are able to shoot a variety of random tipped arrows. This also applies to strays which will still also apply slowness ontop. When killed they have a high chance to drop their quiver complete with its content. This is one of 2 ways to obtain a quiver

Tweaks: Throwable Bricks.text: Introducing vandalism in Minecraft! Throw bricks at your foes Thrown bricks can break glass blocks in a random pattern

Tweaks: Throwable Slimeballs.text: Can bounce off anything When they hit something they will make the entity have a slimed overlay Slimed overlay halves jump height (can be turned off) Using soap or swimmig will clear the slimed overlay Slimes themselves can also inflict this effect when hitting an entity directly

Tweaks: XP Bottling.text: By shift clicking on an enchanting table with a bottle or jar you will be able to bottle some of your experience inside it at the cost of some health

Tweaks: Placeable Sticks and Rods.text: Sticks can be placed on the ground, up to 3 in the same block Blaze Rods can also be placed down with similar properties Blaze rods will damage entities standing on them, setting them on fire. When submerged in water they will emit bubbles

Tweaks: Exploration Map Quills.text: This feature is only on with Quark Replaces exploration maps with Maps and Quill. In vanilla when you open a chest the game hangs up and can lag quite a bit while it tries to find a structure target. Here instead this happens only when the quill is used and can happen offthread with no lag Note that this feature has the side effect that quills get placed in chest regardless if a structure exist nearly or not, as opposed to what happens on vanilla where after a big lag spik you would not find any map in the chest Instead youll get a quill which, if it fails, can still be used further away to…

Tweaks: Misc.text: Inserting a Pancake into a Jukebox will play a new tune, Pancake Music (Credits to STiiX) Added a new Bomb themed painting You can dispense bundle and quiver content with a dispenser Shulker Shells can be worn in the head slot Flower pots can how be hanged from the ceiling Notch apples can now be... unenchanted?? Cartography Tables have animated slot icons You can add item lore by crafting a name tag with any item Banner pattern, Sherds and Paintings have tooltip previews Vines can be placed below campfires You can increase sign text color brightness Sign text color is correctly shader…

World-and-Entities: Way Signs.text: A new structure that will randomly spawn in the overworld Way signs can come with up to two sign posts, each of which will point to the nearest villages Additionally they can also point to some other modded "manmade" structures

World-and-Entities: Cave Urns.text: Small patches of urns will now spawn when deep enough undeground When broken urns will drop an assortment of various loot, most commonly including ash and bones or a few ores but it can rarely include very good loot such as bombs, emeralds, or enchanted armor pieces Loot quality is affected by fortune so be sure to smash them with your fortune pick!

World-and-Entities: Fireflies (1.16 only.text: A new passive mob that spawns at night and does nothing except wandering around blinking whenever it pleases Can spawn in plain, swampy and magic biomes If caught with jars will display a special animation inside them

World-and-Entities: Red Merchant.text: A rare Wandering trader-like merchant Its spawning frequency is low but increases with the passing of days (local difficulty), game difficulty and milestone achieved (killing the ender dragon) It sells an assortment of explosive related items
